validity.final_validation_truncated_flag: All three final responses set native_truncated while returning all required refs; optional candidates also affect this flag. Whole-item byte-budget omissions are reported separately.

memory.destructive_observation_scope: Instrumented controller traces, not an independent audit of all external database activity.
qualitative_findings: The successful asset-dependencies M1 handoff note (1954 bytes) was supplied to the M2 work model. It still described manifest-order tie breaking, while the full current M2 brief explicitly corrected that rule to lexicographic ordering. The common system prompt marked historical memory fallible and the current brief/source authoritative.

Notice-syntax M2 received one current Native revision1 assertion restating the old exact request shape. Its statement that the input has exactly action/pattern/bindings is superseded by the visible M2 brief's optional missing field. Only this one of six stored facts was selected/delivered; the old unconditional missing-binding-default fact itself was not retrieved.

Asset-dependencies M2 PG delivery included the version-qualified original manifest-order ready-node policy. The complete current brief explicitly superseded it with lexicographic ready-node ordering. This is semantic staleness relative to the new task, not a stale Native revision or temporal-pin failure.

Asset-dependencies M2 maintenance successfully revised three facts and added three closure facts. M3 delivery included the corrected ordering rule at revision2, the revised blocked-output rule at revision2, and two new closure facts. The old revision1 ordering rule was not delivered to M3.

All eighteen successfully written/revised fact versions cite spans wholly within the current visible brief's serialized field, rather than the later work-message portion of the boundary transcript. This establishes the citation region only, not semantic entailment or a usefulness score.

All twelve lexical searches report native_truncated=false. The three final required-reference responses report native_truncated=true while returning every requested ref. Frozen Native code also sets this flag when optional candidates exceed max_items; it is not evidence of missing required refs. Separate 2048-byte delivery clipping omitted one whole item at asset M2 and two at asset M3.
observability_limits: Provenance checks prove exact spans/quotes in the current visible transcript, not semantic entailment or task usefulness.
Actual work-prompt inclusion proves memory text was supplied to the model; it does not prove attention, causal use or benefit.
Native currentness is checked against registered refs, returned temporal selection bounds and fresh required-reference responses. Same bounds are not an MVCC snapshot or a commit watermark.
MemoryItem has no scope_id; scope evidence is the exact issued request, bound registry and acknowledged same-scope creation/provenance chain, not an independently returned item scope field.
No pending exclusions were proposed. Pending readability is 0/0 and no live nonempty pending-exclusion behavior is established by this cohort.
No destructive method appears in the instrumented controller traces. This is not an independent audit of all external database activity.
No independent post-failure database dump was inspected. The failed PG boundary's no-assertion-write finding rests on complete serial intent/receipt traces and the frozen prevalidation control flow.
The retained index's claimed tree digest matches the supplied digest; every indexed file content/size was independently verified. No alternate tree-canonicalization algorithm is asserted.
Model usage, costs, elapsed durations, hidden case grouping and grading were not re-audited here.

usage.arm_total_comparison_limit: Executed work counts differ (6, 3, 5); raw arm totals are not matched-task cost or efficiency estimates.

caveats: Controller elapsed_ns intervals have per-process monotonic origins; they are not cross-process timestamps.
Host timestamp envelopes use millisecond wall-clock observations, including orchestration and observation delay.
Capture has no dedicated start event: its envelope starts at observed work completion, not an invented export start.
Model/Native/candidate durations are nested in work/retrieval/maintenance/grading envelopes; do not add them as disjoint stages.
Missing endpoints remain unknown. Bridge duration and provider API duration are distinct clocks, not causal attribution.
Shared startup excludes unobserved setup before the first infrastructure intent. The canary envelope includes bridge initialization; neither window is an invented disjoint total.
Runtime and controller failure/uncertainty cost partitions overlap; valid response costs in a failed maintenance session are still retained.
No task correctness, speedup, significance or reproducible performance-defect inference is made.

task_release.includes: Original synthetic briefs, canonical trees, acceptance cases, reference and defective implementations; source payloads retain their base64 encoding.

interpretation.observed_availability: No-memory completed 6/6 planned slots, handoff 3/6 and pg_agmemory 5/6. Differences here are dependent-unrun outcomes from memory-boundary contract failures, not observed wrong candidate answers.
interpretation.history_label_limit: The preregistered history category records an earlier-visible requirement origin, not proof that the information is absent from the current canonical code or brief.
interpretation.baseline_ceiling: All no-memory slots and historical checks passed. Canonical continuations expose prior parser and graph behavior, so this pilot does not establish a need for extra narrative memory.
interpretation.robustness: Fail-closed guards preserved contracts but three invalid maintenance outputs prevented four later work slots.
interpretation.next_work_not_performed: Improve maintenance-output contract reliability in separately labeled regression work; any renewed held-out usefulness claim requires separately preregistered tasks, not replacement of these outcomes.
